rules: One record per game and source date (date_dim as the source writes it; Disney = UTC, Dice/Domino undocumented).
Every field: definition + source + definition_status in field_definitions (definition_refs_by_game maps record paths to def_ids).
Missing values are null with null_reasons[<dotted path>]; never 0. Domino active_users is null until the DAU definition is approved.
Ads are a separate channel (revenue_channels.ads), never added into iap_total or the segment revenue fields.
user_type new + returning can be below the day total by unknown_new_flag_rows (users with no install value). platform other = not ios/android.
Revenue rounded to 2 decimals (game_metrics keeps whole USD).
Observation (not corrected): Dice user_type.new.ad_revenue_usd is 0 on 36 of 38 days (2026-09-25..11-01); the source ad_revenues is 0 on install-day rows. Cause not documented.
is_final / field_completeness use tools/completeness_rules.json, same as game_metrics.

source.sql: SELECT date_dim, COUNT(1) AS user_rows, COUNTIF(IFNULL(sessions_cnt,0) > 0) AS active, COUNTIF(IFNULL(revenues_sum,0) > 0) AS payers, COUNTIF(DATE(ftd_ts) = date_dim) AS ftd_users, COUNTIF((install_date = date_dim) IS NULL) AS unk_new_rows, SUM(IFNULL(revenues_sum,0)) AS gross, SUM(IFNULL(net_revenues_sum,0)) AS net, SUM(IFNULL(ad_revenues,0)) AS ad, SUM(IFNULL(apple_stripe_purchase_amount,0)) AS apple_stripe_g, SUM(IFNULL(apple_stripe_purchase_net_amount,0)) AS apple_stripe_n, SUM(IFNULL(app_charge_purchase_amount,0)) AS appcharge_g, SUM(IFNULL(app_charge_purchase_net_amount,0)) AS appcharge_n, SUM(IFNULL(dice_dreams_plus_purchase_amount,0)) AS dice_plus_g, SUM(IFNULL(dice_dreams_plus_purchase_net_amount,0)) AS dice_plus_n, COUNTIF((install_date = date_dim) AND IFNULL(sessions_cnt,0) > 0) AS new_active, COUNTIF((install_date = date_dim) AND IFNULL(revenues_sum,0) > 0) AS new_payers, SUM(IF(install_date = date_dim, IFNULL(revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS new_gross, SUM(IF(install_date = date_dim, IFNULL(net_revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS new_net, SUM(IF(install_date = date_dim, IFNULL(ad_revenues,0), 0)) AS new_ad, COUNTIF((NOT (install_date = date_dim)) AND IFNULL(sessions_cnt,0) > 0) AS ret_active, COUNTIF((NOT (install_date = date_dim)) AND IFNULL(revenues_sum,0) > 0) AS ret_payers, SUM(IF(NOT (install_date = date_dim), IFNULL(revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS ret_gross, SUM(IF(NOT (install_date = date_dim), IFNULL(net_revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS ret_net, SUM(IF(NOT (install_date = date_dim), IFNULL(ad_revenues,0), 0)) AS ret_ad, COUNTIF((LOWER(IFNULL(platform,'unknown')) = 'ios') AND IFNULL(sessions_cnt,0) > 0) AS ios_active, COUNTIF((LOWER(IFNULL(platform,'unknown')) = 'ios') AND IFNULL(revenues_sum,0) > 0) AS ios_payers, SUM(IF(LOWER(IFNULL(platform,'unknown')) = 'ios', IFNULL(revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS ios_gross, SUM(IF(LOWER(IFNULL(platform,'unknown')) = 'ios', IFNULL(net_revenues_sum,0), 0)) AS ios_net,
